in_sanskrit.name: किर्तिकुमार
in_sanskrit.meaning: Famous younger brother or Renowned son
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: किर्ति (Kirti) meaning 'fame, glory, renown, or distinction' and कुमार (Kumar) meaning 'younger brother or son'

in_hindi.name: किर्तिकुमार
in_hindi.long_meaning: शानदार (Shaan-dhaar) meaning 'famous' and आदमी (Aad-mi) meaning 'man' or 'male'

in_telugu.name: కిర్తికుమార్
in_telugu.long_meaning: చేదియే (Che-de-yi) meaning 'renowned' and ఆదేశ (Aa-de-sh) meaning 'lord' or 'master'

in_marathi.name: Kirtikumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun God's Mark
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kirtikumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kirti refers to fame and glory, and Kumar refers to a young boy. The name Kirtikumar can be interpreted as 'the mark of the Sun God on a young boy'. In Hindu mythology, the Sun God is revered as a symbol of power, energy, and creativity. This name is believed to bestow upon the child these divine qualities.

The name Kirtikumar can be interpreted as 'the mark of the Sun God on a young boy'. In Hindu mythology, the Sun God is revered as a symbol of power, energy, and creativity. This name is believed to bestow upon the child these divine qualities.
